summary: A native button that copies an install command to the clipboard and shows a Copied! label for two seconds.
use: Copy-to-clipboard affordances for install commands, API keys and share links.
spec: `use:clipboard={'bun add @codeatlasdev/ui'}` imported from `@codeatlasdev/ui/actions` on a native `<button`
`oncopy={done}` sets `copied = true` and resets it with `setTimeout(() => (copied = false), 2000)`
Label switches with state: `{copied ? 'Copied!' : 'Copy install command'}`
